admin.title: Configuration Panel
admin.subtitle: Configure Sage's behavior
admin.d1.desc: Deterministic pattern filtering — detects technical attacks in input (SQL injection, XSS, command injection), LLM control delimiters and credential exposure, including base64-obfuscated variants
admin.d2.desc: Semantic classification via LLM — analyzes user intent to detect prompt injection, instruction override attempts, data exfiltration and malicious behaviors not capturable by regex
admin.d3.desc: Rigid system prompt protection — injects priority security rules that prevent leaking of internal instructions, credentials and any override or manipulation attempt on model behavior
admin.d4.desc: Behavioral and context restriction — reinforces model alignment by limiting scope, blocking roleplay, preventing indirect prompt injection (RAG poisoning) and avoiding manipulation via memory/conversation
admin.d5.desc: Semantic response validation — uses LLM to detect sensitive information leakage in output (PII, credentials, system prompt, infrastructure) and generate a safe version when needed
admin.d6.desc: Deterministic output sanitization — applies multiple cleaning layers: HTML neutralization (anti-XSS), URL removal (anti-exfiltration), PII and credential masking, and detection of sensitive data hidden in base64
admin.rag.enabled_desc: Enables context retrieval from documents in app/documents/ via in-memory embeddings
admin.rag.reindex_desc: Reindex deletes the current index and recreates embeddings from documents in app/documents/. Use after editing .md files or changing the embedding model.
